text: Harry Frankfurt's hierarchical (source) account locates free will in:
choices: The agent's capacity to have done otherwise
The causation of the action by the agent as a substance
Acting from a first-order desire that the agent endorses with a second-order desire (identifies with)
explanation: Frankfurt's hierarchical compatibilism locates freedom in acting from a first-order desire that one endorses with a second-order desire - a will one identifies with - rather than in alternative possibilities. Option 1 is the leeway/PAP condition Frankfurt actually attacks, option 0 is incompatibilism, and option 2 is agent-causation; each is a rival account of freedom.
